action.sql: WITH ps AS (SELECT product_id, min(supplier_id) sup FROM purchase_order GROUP BY 1) SELECT date_trunc('week', l.date) w, sum(CASE WHEN sup='SUP-001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost_s1, sum(CASE WHEN sup<>'SUP-001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lost_other FROM lost_sale l JOIN ps USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
